in_sanskrit.name: उमासंकर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who constantly meditates on Goddess Uma (Parvati), the consort of Lord Shiva.

in_hindi.name: उमासंकर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is content with Goddess Uma (Parvati).

in_telugu.name: ఊమాసంగర
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the consort of Goddess Uma (Parvati) and Lord Shiva.

in_marathi.name: Umasankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Umasankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Uma (Goddess of Marriage and Fertility) + Sankar (God of Knowledge)

in_bengali.name: Umasankar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Umasankar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Uma (Goddess of Marriage and Fertility) + Sankar (God of Knowledge)
